Rent equipment by the hour

addEquipment accepts an optional hourlyPrice. A rental shorter than a
day that starts and ends on the hour is priced at the hourly price for
each hour; an item without one cannot be rented by the hour. book prices
a period before recording it, so a period that cannot be priced books
nothing.
